tasks.subject: Task 3: query_to_array(db, sql, dtype)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run a SELECT and collect rows into a numpy structured array of the caller dtype, writing cells by field offset (xColumn in reverse), geometric NRT growth + trim. Output dtype passed as numba.from_dtype typeref (A2 cache-key rule).

**Verify:** /home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/pytest test/core/test_sqlite_query.py -q


tasks.subject: Task 6: create_module_v2 + xDestroy registry cleanup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Register register_table + register_tvf modules via sqlite3_create_module_v2 with a ctypes xDestroy callback that pops a module-level registry (keyed by descriptor pointer) on teardown — fixing the caller-must-retain-handle hazard. xDestroy does Python pop only (no sqlite3_free of numpy-owned descriptor) per A4.

**Verify:** /home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/pytest test/core/test_sqlite_vtable.py -k 'xdestroy or cleanup or registry' -q

```json:metadata
{"files": ["numbox/core/bindings/_sqlite_vtable.py", "numbox/core/bindings/_sqlite_tvf.py", "test/core/test_sqlite_vtable.py"], "verifyCommand": "/home/erik/projects/numbox/venv/bin/pytest test/core/test_sqlite_vtable.py -k 'xdestroy or cleanup or registry' -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["registry entry removed on close (one xDestroy)", "two tables two removals", "duplicate name first-at-rereg second-at-close", "no C-free of numpy descriptor, no UAF"]}
```
